Name: Solid Gold Lewis Sprinkler (1.6 Version)
Author: plasmoasis
Description:
[left][size=4]﻿This mod uses [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22167]Sprinkler Mod Redux[/url]﻿ to turn the Solid Gold Lewis statue into a functional sprinkler.
Compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/17642]Statue Shorts[/url].


[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/18126]The original mod[/url]﻿ had a discrepancy with the config not matching up with the item entry.
I fixed that and changed the default from 10 tiles (21x21-1) to 3 tiles (7x7-1).
You can change this at any time in game using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]GMCM[/url]!﻿
[/size][/left]
